algorithm.capacity_formula: new capacity = max(2 * capacity, length + additional, minimum capacity), unsigned comparisons throughout; the doubling is a bare lea and wraps modulo 2^64 unchecked (capacity 2^63 doubles to 0 and loses the max; capacity 2^64 - 1 doubles to 2^64 - 2 and wins it)
